title: Naive Bayes lies about independence and often wins
body: Naive Bayes assumes features are independent given the class, flagrantly false for words in a sentence, yet it classifies text surprisingly well because ranking the classes correctly needs less than true probabilities. Spam filters ran on it for years. A model can be wrong as physics and right as engineering simultaneously, which ML veterans learn to stop apologising for.
source_hint: Naive Bayes text classification literature (McCallum and Nigam, 1998)
